subject: website
name: James Carnley
summary: James Carnley's homepage, open source (MIT). It loads only its own files. Its videos are the one connection elsewhere, and the page says so: pressing play loads the video from YouTube, and until then nothing on the page talks to Google. That keeps it Level 4. It is not private: once a video plays, YouTube sees the reader's IP address, with no proxy in between.

connections.name: YouTube videos
connections.note: Loaded only when the reader presses play, which the page explains beside each video.
